Overview

Lleida is a city in Catalonia with a population of 140,000. A historic city in western Catalonia with a striking Gothic cathedral, a rich agricultural region, and affordable living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
